description: Hollows, sunken basins between overhanging plateaus whose clean springs flow out of tunnels: the industry fills the basins around the start, the three Deep Ore Sources lie in the northern, western and eastern hollows, the two Deep Ore Veins and both quarry seams in the south-east, and the five Human Record Caches each beside its own Archive Excavation site, four along the northern rim and one in the far south-east.
